method.frontend: TypeScript AST named invoke imports and named guest imports; literal/local-or-imported constant command arguments. Static/dynamic literal module imports from src/main.ts mark potential reachability, not runtime execution.
method.rust: Comment/string-aware lexical calls and function signatures; exact cfg(test) blocks excluded. No name resolution, general macro expansion, cfg evaluation or full call graph.
method.kotlin: Comment/string-aware @Command declarations only; bridge selector calls separately inventory Rust source and known pty_bridge macro inputs.
method.scope: src production TS/Vue, src-tauri/src Rust, local plugin Rust/guest/Kotlin and permission/capability source. Tests/docs/fixtures do not count as consumers.
